name: notice-changes

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/countdown_test.go — a notice when ending or ends_by changes, and while ending is true when ends_at moves; none outside a window; the warning withdrawn with ending false

description: The countdown's warning (session model §11 expiry_notice; T6): a notice goes to attached clients when ending or ends_by changes, and while ending is true when ends_at moves — never outside a window. idle moves with every byte, so a notice on every change of ends_at would be a frame per output chunk; this way a warning appears (a link that stops answering: ends in 6 min), updates, and is withdrawn — ending false, as when a flapping link recovers — and nothing else is sent. It reaches a client only under short lab timers, so the core's own test grades it.
